title: Mä Jisk’a Yatiyawi Janïr mä Marcha Anfitriona
intro: Mä valleruw mantasma, kawkhantï mä chʼamani apnaqeri ukat mä jachʼa ejercitojj jakʼachasipki, ukat mä jiskʼa viajerojj mä ewjjtʼa churaski uk amuytʼam, ukajj taqpach markaruw qhespiyaraki. Kunjamakitix amenazat comunidadax imantañ utar purinxi ukhax jan walt’awix pasawayxiwa. Uka iwxtʼa qhipäxan jan uñjat jaqir uñtʼañatakix pʼiqiñchäwinakarjam sarnaqañamawa.
clues: Mä apnaqirin reinopampi chiktʼat jiskʼa animalanak taypinktwa.
Nayan markajax mä valle manqhankir utanakan jakasi, ukanx maynix mayninakaruw jawsaspa.
Uka apnaqirimpi ukat apnaqirimp chika viajipki uka ejercitonakatsa mä amenazampiw uñjastanjja.
Nayaw markajarux jawst’ta, jupanakan utanakapar mantapxañapataki, ukat jan yatkasin jan ch’allxtasipxañasatakiw iwxt’istu.
Uka apnaqirix Sulayman satawa, ukat nayan kastajax jupan apnaqawipar uchat luratanaka taypinkiwa.
Nayajj uka vallenkir chʼiwinakätwa; nayax iwxt’atajatsti, utanakajaruw mantapxta ukat jan yatkasin katjapxirïtu uka t’unjäwinakat qhispipxta.

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
